unlisted_practices: Pre-populating mandated VTE risk assessment forms from routinely collected EHR data using machine learning, with clinician verification, to improve timeliness of completion
Comparing concordance between clinician-completed risk assessment forms and structured EHR data

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of EHR data and machine learning feasibility for automating/pre-populating VTE risk assessments compared to clinician-recorded forms across NHS hospitals; does not prospectively evaluate or compare a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
